title: Robust Cross-Dataset Generalization of Machine Learning-Based Network Intrusion Detection Under Temporal and Distributional Shift
stage: v3 addendum to frozen v2; v2 targets previously inspected; public UCI metadata, including class descriptions, read before freeze. External model outcomes not inspected.
target: UCI RT-IoT2022, DOI 10.24432/C5P338, official release, all rows, no target training, threshold fitting, test-driven scaling, model selection, balancing or row removal
source_training: Use the actual fitted controlled models on the CICIOT2023 target loop of v2, with sources UNSW_NB15, TON_IOT and UNSW_NB15+TON_IOT. Exclude CIC training. No additional fitting to RT. Same source rows, calibrators and weights as v2.
RT_features: proto string to tcp/udp/icmp/other as UNSW mapping; flow_duration in Zeek FlowMeter seconds, raw nonnegative then log1p with same float precision as UNSW. No conversion fitted on target. ID, service and Attack_type excluded.
RT_labels: Normal device activity: MQTT/Publish, ThingSpeak, Wipro bulb, Amazon Alexa (if present). Attacks: published DoS SYN Hping, ARP poisoning, Nmap scans, DDoS Slowloris and SSH brute force. Case and punctuation insensitive; fail on unrecognized labels. Resolve spelling only from dataset metadata; publish all actual labels and counts.
thresholds: v2 source-calibrated benign 1% FPR policy, max of source thresholds
primary_external_contrast: pooled vs each single source, LightGBM minimal_core Macro-F1 at 0.5, mean over the three seeds on all target rows; show both signed differences without choosing a winning source
secondary: All conditions including Majority, protocol-only, alternate threshold, FPR, recall, ROC-AUC, average precision, raw confusion. Descriptive, no confirmatory p-values or treatment of seeds as replications. Report common-feature overlap separately without tuning or excluding rows.
calibration_sensitivity: Strict v2 native LR and LightGBM for both calendar datasets. Keep fitted models and entire original tests identical. For the original calibration day use full day and first/second half divided at midpoint of observed calibration time span, cutoff included in second half. For each use empirical benign tail budgets 1%, 0.5%, 0.1%, min 30 benign. Freeze quantile tie rule from v2. Report all eligible policies, n and actual windows, achieved calibration FPR, fixed test FPR and recall, confusion and Macro-F1. No policy selection. These subwindows are not new independent days.
analyses: Pair minimal_core minus protocol_only and ML minus Majority within the same source/target/seed/threshold for every controlled model. RQ3 collapse seeds over the nine transfer conditions; show per-model descriptive Spearman and feature/class examples. No causal or general monotonic claim.
scope: A previously unused public testbed in this project, evaluated by this project. No claim of independent investigators, preregistration by a third party, or production deployment.
